versions.changelog:
- Initial release of hizal-search.
- Skill triggers automatically whenever context retrieval is needed, before starting new work.
- Supports semantic search, scope filtering, chunk type filtering, query_key lookups, compaction, and version history inspection.
- Designed to prevent duplicate work by surfacing prior decisions, conventions, and relevant knowledge from Hizal.
- Covers a broad range of use cases, including searching via feature name, ticket ID, subsystem, or agent memory.
